blocks.text: Peroxisomes tamam eukaryotic cells mein paye jane wale organelles hain jo ek membrane se ghire hain. Inhen bhi Christian de Duve ne daryaft kiya, jinhon ne lysosomes daryaft kiye the.

Peroxisomes mein kai qisam ke enzymes hote hain. In mein se bohat se oxidative hain, yani oxidation karte hain: electrons aur hydrogens ko hatate hain. Yeh enzymes khaas taur par cell ko zehreele maddon se pak karte hain. Kuch peroxisomes, jaise jigar ke cells wale, alcohol aur doosre nuqsan-deh compounds ko oxidise kar ke be-zehr (detoxify) karte hain.
Kuch peroxisomes mein catalase enzyme hota hai jo hydrogen peroxide (cell ke metabolism ki ek aam zimni paidawar, by-product) ko pani aur oxygen mein tor deta hai:

blocks.alt: Peroxisome jo proteins wali ek membrane mein band hai; andar daanedar matrix aur enzyme urate oxidase ka gehra crystal jaisa markaz (core) hai. Bara kiya gaya daira membrane ko lipid bilayer dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.24: Peroxisome ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 3.24 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Andar ka gehra crystal urate oxidase enzyme ka hai.

Peroxisomes ki kharabi se kai metabolic beemariyan hoti hain. In mein sab se sangeen Zellweger syndrome hai, jis mein cells mein peroxisomes bilkul nahi hote ya bohat kam hote hain. Yeh congenital (paidaishi) beemari hai; is ka koi ilaj nahi aur aam taur par pehle saal hi mein maut ho jati hai.
